verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes a structured agentic-commerce v1 API reference covering create cart and get cart, with documented response codes and JWT auth. It also offers a sandbox where developers can run test API calls. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or includes runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable code examples embedded in the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either.
